prompt: A cinematic, photorealistic wide shot of a massive bipedal police robot standing inside a large industrial hangar on a rainy day. The robot is the central focus, towering over the scene with a complex mechanical design featuring white armored plating and exposed black hydraulic joints. It has a multi-lens camera array for a head instead of a face, and red warning lights are illuminated on its shoulders. The text "警視庁 MPD" (Metropolitan Police Department) is printed in black on its chest plates and arms. Its feet are wide, treaded platforms resting on the wet concrete floor. To the left, a vertical banner hangs from the ceiling reading "警視庁 METROPOLITAN POLICE DEPARTMENT" with a cherry blossom crest. Below it, a horizontal sign reads "安全な東京を 次の世代へ A SAFER TOKYO FOR THE NEXT GENERATION". In the background, through the open hangar doors, heavy rain falls over a Tokyo cityscape featuring the red lattice structure of the Tokyo Tower and modern skyscrapers under a grey sky. Several police trucks marked "MPD" are parked outside with their headlights on. Two human officers wearing dark uniforms and white helmets stand in the foreground corners, providing scale.
